item.title: Kennedy Center's new programming head resigns days after hiring announcement
item.description: The new head of artistic programming at the Kennedy Center, Kevin Couch, has resigned after just weeks on the job, according to several reports. The Kennedy Center announced on Jan. 16 that Couch, the former programming head for a U.K.-based theater owner and production company, had been named its senior vice president of artistic programming.
